vignette: 67-year-old man with ischemic cardiomyopathy, NYHA class IV symptoms, and LVEF 15% by echocardiography. He has been on guideline-based optimal medical management for 58 of the last 60 days without response and is dependent on continuous milrinone after two failed weaning attempts. He is not a transplant candidate. The requested device is a durable LVAD FDA approved for long-term mechanical circulatory support (destination therapy). The implanting cardiothoracic surgeon has implanted 34 durable intracorporeal LVADs in the previous 36 months, 11 of them in the last year. The facility-based VAD team includes an advanced heart failure cardiologist experienced in VAD management before and after implant, a VAD program coordinator, a social worker, and a palliative care specialist. The hospital is credentialed as an LVAD facility by a CMS-approved credentialing organization.
rationale_note: NYHA IV, LVEF 15%, inotrope dependent, OMM 58/60 days failing; full team, credentialed facility.

rationale_note: Boundaries: LVEF exactly 25%, OMM exactly 45 of last 60 days, surgeon exactly 10 LVADs in 36 months with 2 in the last year.

vignette: 73-year-old woman who underwent aortic valve replacement and coronary bypass surgery today and could not be weaned from cardiopulmonary bypass despite inotropes. Her pre-operative LVEF was 35% and she had NYHA class II symptoms. The surgeon requests a temporary VAD that is FDA approved for post-cardiotomy circulatory support, to be used according to its FDA-approved labeling. The implanting cardiothoracic surgeon has implanted 34 durable intracorporeal LVADs in the previous 36 months, 11 of them in the last year. The facility-based VAD team includes an advanced heart failure cardiologist experienced in VAD management before and after implant, a VAD program coordinator, a social worker, and a palliative care specialist. The hospital is credentialed as an LVAD facility by a CMS-approved credentialing organization.
rationale_note: Post-cardiotomy indication: device FDA approved for post-cardiotomy support per labeling. LVEF 35% and NYHA criteria apply to the LVAD heart failure indication, not this one.
